input: Parse /var/log/access.log to find the top 3 most requested URL paths. Each line has format 'METHOD /path STATUS'. Print each URL with its count, sorted by count descending.

transcript.final_response:
These are the 3 most requested URL paths in `/var/log/access.log`:

```
/api/items 4
/api/users 4
/api/health 2
```

`/api/items` and `/api/users` both have 4 requests, so they're tied for first. When counts are equal, the paths are listed alphabetically. The log has only 10 lines, so the three paths above cover all of them. Every method (GET, POST, etc.) counts toward the path it requested.

Command used:
```bash
awk '{c[$2]++} END{for(u in c) print c[u], u}' /var/log/access.log | sort -k1,1nr -k2 | head -3 | awk '{print $2, $1}'
```
